## My Journey

I am originally from Kigali, Rwanda.

Before beginning my Master of Data Science, I worked as a Global Graduate Trainee in Customer Value Management at MTN Rwandacell, where I contributed to reports, dashboards, customer engagement analysis, and data-driven business insights.

I am also the founder of Unity Lens, an initiative exploring how artificial intelligence and virtual reality can support historical preservation and peace education.
